title: Digimon Battle Spirit - Toy Town
description:
Originally, Syn the Fox ripped this BG and I used Lunar Magic Bitmap Pasting Feature to convert it to SMW.

Since this BG doesn't scroll, you either leave it without scrolling, except vertically or add really slow horizontal scrolling to the BG.

Uses the second half of palette 4.
Please give credit to Syn the Fox, not me.
I only did my job.
